hero.title: What legacy finance tools really cost you
hero.lede: There is no sticker price on a slow month-end close or a finance team buried in manual work. Here is what those hidden costs add up to, and what changes when you switch.
toll.title: The hidden toll of doing nothing
toll.subtitle: Every month on disconnected systems is money left on the table.
item-1.label: Slow month-end close
item-1.body: Teams on legacy tools spend weeks reconciling entities by hand instead of steering the business.
item-2.label: Manual reporting
item-2.body: Stitching spreadsheets across subsidiaries burns hours that never show up on an invoice.
item-3.label: Audit and error risk
item-3.body: Untracked entries and missing approval history turn every audit into a fire drill.
item-4.label: Slower decisions
item-4.body: Rearview reporting means you learn what happened after it is too late to act on it.
